items.text: Sandakwajeanda neajeeda geeyeadu jeeda gheeda sibata ASEETA

Ng'ata ghoamughuush Sulemani gweargwa Israeli, ea fuga hees bea eemoojiga, ea sugoodiga ghweaniga gealga fuga Israeli, aba madeeda sugoocheanda was Sulemani aba Yerusalemu, gweadu sandakwajeanda neajeeda bea NG'UTAMIIDA aba mujiineeda Dawdi was Sayuni.
Hean gooweameesa heeda sugoocheanda was Sulemani headiga sean bea Israeli damanda ghweelmeeda damanda sheeda siguura Etanimu, was sheeda ispwa.
Hean ghapka gweargwa sean bea Israeli, hean ghwasar ashoohoodiga sandakwajeanda.
Gweadu sandakwajeanda NG'UTAMIIDA, ea maheemajeanda siroondooscheesa, ea dabita sean ghaydit mida jeeda maheemajeanda; hean ghwasar ashoohoodiga ea fuga Lawi ea gooscheeng'u.

Ak sugoocheanda was Sulemani ea eemeetuw bea Israeli abeeda bassa geat madeadaanyi, gwandayeesa niny madeeda sandakwajeanda, nea gwasin lukghumajeega saang'a nea gisilga ea heewga manda iitooda nyaawa.
Ng'ata gweadu ashoohoodiga sandakwajeanda neajeeda bea NG'UTAMIIDA ea ghwahita heechea goobiida, bugusta gheeda heeda ghaydit, was heeda ghaydit muuchi, mida hing'eadayda meang'eega geeruubajeanda.
Aba gideaba geeruubajeega goodearsa dabiniga nyaawa badayda beega mida sandakwajeanda neajeeda geeruubajeega hean gwaduk heeda duukusa heetiyeada bea sandakwajeanda neajeeda ea daranajeagaaschi.

Nea daranajeega ea geawi muuchi aba gideaba iheenga geediga geedeekna heeda ghaydit madeeda jeeda gheeda ghaydit; nea ea miidaachi aba meatkweeda duukusa jarooda; ak ea gudu gwanda hoowa ea ghoah ghamneawa.

Ak ea manda gil nuut jeeda sandakwajeanda neajeeda geaghus measaji iyeenya bea lagheanga ghayi iin jeeda Musa aba Horebu, heeda sissa NG'UTAMIIDA neajeeda sea fuga Israeli, damanda rinna ng'eanyiida Misri.
Ak inyeesa gheata rinna ashoohoodiga jeeda gheeda ghaydit, inyeesa gwaduk shamooghooda gheeda NG'UTAMIIDA,
inyeesa gwayi bwak ea ghwaraay gagadiiy ashoohoodiga aba ng'asheega shamooghooda; aba gideaba ghoanyiit giigheambiita NG'UTAMIIDA jeeda gheeda NG'UTAMIIDA.
Hean gwayi Sulemani,
Sulemani goorgweaksa buuneeda
Hean ghwayam geaw sugoocheanda, ak gabadiischeesa guuyeeda Israeli, damanda gheata gudu ghamiinaadawa eemeetuw bea Israeli.
Ak gwayi, “Gagasa eekghaambiit NG'UTAMIIDA, ASEETA fuga Israeli, niny aba geatindaanyi niihiit gidaghayi heeleesa sea ghweandeanyu was Dawdi aba ghuutaanyi, nea gwayi,

‘Gidang'eada eaweeda ghayi earuuni fugeasu bea Israeli aba ng'eanyiida Misri, manda mujiineeda aaghwali aba jeeda eemoojiga sean bea fuga Israeli jea dadeeksa gheeda, goobiida gheawungeasu hoowa; hean ghaaloachi Dawdi ghoah siichea ghoahaaghwa fugeasu bea Israeli.’
Ak hean ghayi gwanda jeeda guroorooda ghweandeanyu was Dawdi gideaba gayghwadeas gheeda aba gheawunga NG'UTAMIIDA, ASEETA fuga Israeli.
Ng'ata gwayeesha NG'UTAMIIDA ghweandeanyu was Dawdi, ‘Aba gideaba ghayi gwanda gurooroadaang'u deesta gheeda aba gheawungeasu, giidoabiiwi aba ng'asheanda mida gurooroadaang'u,
ak ang'iing'i ea maydeeknean gheeda, nea orjeedang'u jea jiila ang'iing'i gayghwadeas gheeda aba gheawungeasu.’

Ak ghamneawa NG'UTAMIIDA niihiit heeleesiinda ghayi sin; aba gideaba naamiinaadawi heeda ghweandeanyu was Dawdi, ak geapteadawi hoorgeeda gheambalmeeda bea Israeli, gawuurji gidaghayi heeleesiinda NG'UTAMIIDA, ak ghamneawa ea naadeaschi gheeda aba gheawunga NG'UTAMIIDA, was ASEETA fuga Israeli.
Ak aba hoowa ea neasinyi heechea goobiida sandakwajeanda neajeeda, was neajeeda NG'UTAMIIDA ghayi sin sea ghweanigaasa, damanda gheata aruuna saawa ng'eanyiida Misri.”
Sulemani ghamwaash ASEETA
Ng'ata ghamiinaada Sulemani aba madeeda heeda wagiida bea NG'UTAMIIDA aba madeeda eemeetuw bea Israeli, ak ghamiinda geatingaaschi googeal humng'eeda;

ak gwayi, “Ea NG'UTAMIIDA, was ASEETA Israeli, manda ASEETA uurjeeweey, aba humng'eeda heetiyeada ghana ng'eanyi, ea uuta ng'eanyiida iing'oanyayi neajeeda nea giihiimu baydeayda huumwa aba heeda fugaagu bea gadiyeeda wadiina madeadaang'u aba gurooruunatka nyaawa;
iing'waanyi sea siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda was Dawdi was ghweandeanyu gidaghayi iheeleesi sea niny; asaha nea ghayi gibalooli aba ghuutaang'u, ak ea niihiidi aba geatingaagu gawuurji gideaba ghamneawa.

Ak ghamneawa, Ea NG'UTAMIIDA, was ASEETA Israeli, ang'waanya sea siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda Dawdeeda was ghweandeanyu gidaghayi iheeleesi niny, nea giyeeshi, ‘Aba madeedeanya mayramwasa siichea goopteadawa hoorgeeda Israeli, inyas orjoagaagu gaygwasin mureeda aba giibinda nyaawa, ak gaweewa madeedeanyu gawuurji gidiibeadi ang'iing'i aba madeedeanyu.’
Ak ghamneawa, Ea ASEETA fuga Israeli, nung' ghwanal ng'asheandaang'u, ghayi ibalooli siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda Dawdi was ghweandeanyu.
“Ghamneawa ASEETA ghoamu goobiida badayda ng'eanyiida? Ng'ula, humng'eeda ea humng'eeda sheagi moamu ghoahiinyi; ak gaygawuurjiin gheawi mwanang' aadeaschiin!
Aleaydiit mooshta siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda ea musiischoadaanyi, Ea NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEETEANYU, aleeysiina iit shooka ea mooshta siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda aba madeadaang'u askweareani;

nung' ghwajaada gheanyangaagu ak ging'ulayi gheawi askweari ea eawa, heeda ghayi iyeeni, ‘Gheawungeasu gaygoobiida hiji,’ ak abeeda gwadeepa aleeysiina iita mooshta siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda ruku aba hiji.
Aleeysiina iita mooshta siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda ea gea fugaagu bea Israeli, inyas gamusiischi nea gwayamsa geat hiji, aleaydiit aba humng'eeda heeda iibiiti; aba inyas giyiinyi, abeeda gisamsi.
“Inyas gaygoodiiy siida aba heeda giischeewoocheandaanyi, ak geenung' ghwaak habeawooda, inyas ghoan gweaksa habeawooda madeeda headaang'u wagiida aba jeedeaba gheawi,

abeeda giileaydiit aba humng'eeda, ak gisin, ak giirgweaksi siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda, nea giwali siida muy nea giigeali fughareadaanyi jeeda uhuudaanyi, nea giidawi siida doabiiwaat gidadeaschi ak gibadiischeesi aba doobiiwnataanyi.
“Inyas gajeajoar fugaagu aba madeeda weajoodiga aba gideaba nisineey riing'eeda, inyas gaygabiikneey, ak gwaruku gheawungaagu, ak gamooreey aba jeedeaba gheawi;
abeeda giileaydiit aba humng'eeda ak gisamsi riing'eeda fugaagu bea Israeli, ak abeeda giidealdi gicha ng'eanyiida ghayi iidawi ghweaniga nyaawa.

“Inyas gwatkweada humng'eeda ak ea maroabwana aba gideaba nisineey riing'eeda, inyas gaygamusiischi nea googeal iheenga hiji, ak gwaruku gheawungaagu, ak gwaduukuuna riing'eega nyaawa damanda ijaksi hang'weaniidooda,

aleaydiit aba humng'eeda, ak gisamsi riing'eega soomjoagaagu, fugaagu bea Israeli, gheata iinaali saawa naweeda doabiiwaat jea gweada, ak ginyaksi roopta ng'eanyiidaang'u ghayi iidawi fugaagu ghoah gichea gwahearan.

“Inyas gwanda jeeda ng'eanyiida geejeeda, inyas gwanda dawni ghana nyoota roopta ghana dung'usta ghana deashamga ghana sapsabiida; inyas gayghaghas weajoodiga nyaawa aba jeeda mujiinajeega nyaawa; gwadeepa ea geeyoonung'weaka gil ghana miyeanyeeka,
aleeysiina iit musiischoodeaba siyagi ghana gea buuneeda sean bea Israeli, gilba siisi nyooh ghwanal geeyooda bearji aba gurooroadaanyi ak ghamiinda geatingaaschi googeal heeda gheawi;

hean aleaydiit aba humng'eeda heeda iibiiti, ak gisamsi, ak gisini, ak ginyaksi gilinyoo nala aba gurooroadaang'u, galana naweadingaaschi (aba gideaba geaghusnyi ang'iing'i siida nal gurooruunatka diibiga buuneeda);
ak gaygwasineey mureeda aba eemoojiga sean jea goobiida jeeda ng'eanyiida ghayi iidawi ghweanigaasa.
“Ak gwasunu aba heeda rabascheanda, maba eemeanagi sea fugaagu bea Israeli, hina ng'eanyiida sheagi aba gheawungaagu
(aba gideaba gayghwayiiy gheawungaagu hees, ea geatindaang'u haw uur ea geatindaang'u doabiiwaat). Inyas ghoan ak gamusiischi nea gawiileesa gheawi,

aleaydiit aba humng'eeda heeda iibiiti, ak gisini gawuurji gidarukuneey siida was rabascheanda, ak abeeda buuneeda sean bea ng'eanyiida gayghwanal gheawungaagu ak nea gayghoawal gheanyangaagu, gawuurji fugaagu bea Israeli, ak nea gayghwanal gideaba gheawi ghayi aadeaschiin gaba gheawungaagu.

“Inyas gaweay fugaagu gang'uchi sea weajoodiga nyaawa, aba naweeda nyooh ajeakteawana, ak ghamwaash NG'UTAMIIDA nea googeal iheenga mujiineeda ghayi ighwali ea gheeda ghayi aadeaschi aba gheawungaagu,
abeeda giileaydiit aba humng'eeda mooshta nyaawa ak hean giweadi gwajooriischi.

“Inyas gwasineey riing'eeda aba gideaba manda siisi masina riing'eeda ak hean ginyareasi, ak giihaagi weajoodiga, ak geayaat ghoah soomjooga aba ng'eanyiida weajoodiga, mida heeda neeki ghana heeda sheagi;

inyas gabumbuniidi gurooruunatka aba ng'eanyiida ghayi siyaat ghoah soomjooga, ak gwaduukuuna, ak gamusnyi aba ng'eanyiida weajoodiga nyaawa, nea gwayi, ‘Sisinyi riing'eeda, ea ng'asheega gwaneadi ea gea munyas’;

inyas gaygwaduukuuna aba jeesinga nyaawa sean eara aba gurooruunatka nyaawa aba ng'eanyiida weajoodiga nyaawa, ghayi aat saawa ghoah soomjooga, inyas gamusnyi nea googeal iheenga ng'eanyiida ghayi iidawi ghweaniga nyaawa, mujiineeda ghayi iloadi, ea gheeda aadeaschi aba gheawungaagu;
abeeda giileeysiit aba humng'eeda heeda iibiiti musiischooda nyaawa ea mooshta nyaawa, ak gisisi doobiiwnata
ak gisamsi fugaagu sinneey riing'eeda, ea giidiinyeanyeeka nyaawa ning'uda geat; danung' ghwanyas baydeayda aba madeeda fuga ghayi aat ghoah soomjooga ak abeeda gaygwasissa baydeayda
(aba gideaba suh fugaagu gil, ea fuga jea gwahearanyi, ghayi iiruuni ng'eanyiida Misri, jeeda duwayda gharinyeanda).
Nung' ghwajaada gheanyangaagu ak giileeysiit mooshta siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda, ea mooshta fugaagu bea Israeli, ak giileeysiit Iinyo gaguuru.

Aba gideaba ghayi giiheeli sea eemoojiga suurja bea jeeda ng'eanyiida, ghoah fuga jea gwahearaniischi, gawuurji gidaghayi irukuneati aba ghuuta siidaang'u bea gadiyeeda was Musa, damanda iiruudu ghweanigaasa aba ng'eanyiida Misri, Ea NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEETA.”
Mooshta ASEETA huuydean
Ng'ata iinea ghoahiit Sulemani musiischooda aba heeda NG'UTAMIIDA, ghang'eat aba madeeda heeda wagiida bea NG'UTAMIIDA, damanda dugunya nea ghamiinda geatingaaschi;
hean ghamiinaada, ak gabadiischeesa fuga sean bwatgeat bea Israeli nea goojuur, nea gwayi,

“Gagasa eebadiischeesa NG'UTAMIIDA niidaw fuufeanda fugaaschi bea Israeli, gawuurji gidaghayi heeleesiinda; nea manda ng'asheanda raay aba jeeda ng'asheega sean ghayi heeleesa miyaas, ghayi rukuna ghuuta siidaanyi bea gadiyeeda was Musa.
NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEETEANYA gagasa goobiida heedeanya, gawuurji gidaghayi abiideata heeda ghweanigaasa; adiidu ghwanung'waneasa heeda ghana gwajaktaneasa;

danung' googeal gurooruunatkaasa headaanyi, ak geayaachi naweadingaaschi, nea geang'waanyi diigheanyeekaaschi atamanamughuush, ea diigheanyeekaaschi ea deaweedajeagaaschi, ghayi rukwiisa ghweanigaasa.

Ak ghamneawa ng'asheesu ikeasu, aamoashchi NG'UTAMIIDEAN gagasa gwaneekiisa heeda NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEETEANYA askweari ea eawa, ak gayghabwayda siidaanyi bea gadiyeeda, ea fugaaschi bea Israeli, aba gilinyoo gagasa galeaga sean;
buuneeda sean bea ng'eanyiida gayghwanal gideaba NG'UTAMIIDA ASEETA gil, nea manda nuut.
Danung' gwadoobiiwi gurooruunatkeagwa aba heeda NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEETEANYA, ak ghoabeawi jeeda diigheanyeekaaschi nea ghoang'waanyi diigheanyeekaaschi atamanamughuush, gawuurji gidoosinyi ghamneawa.”
Giitinda gheeda sibata ASEETA
Ng'ata sugoocheanda niny sea fuga Israeli; ghwayiin lukghumajeega madeeda NG'UTAMIIDA.

Sulemani ghoadayda ghoah lukghumajeega hoyyoo heeda NG'UTAMIIDA heew sagalamnyooji diktam ea iyeenya ea gisil bughala ea diktam. Hean sugoocheanda ea fuga sean bea Israeli gabadiischeesa gheeda NG'UTAMIIDA.

Eaweecheandida sugoocheanda ghoaghaydiit geeda mida bugusta mida madeeda gheeda NG'UTAMIIDA; ak aba hoowa ghoadayda haleanjeeda sisabwa geadi sighwarda ea booga sisabwa geadi ea heeda riisheadi bea hoyyoo, aba gideaba heeda wagiida bea gharinyeanda mida madeeda NG'UTAMIIDA aamwanang' gichea gwasareenuudayi haleanjeeda sigwariida sisabwa geadi, ea gea booga ea gea riisheadi ea gea hoyyoo.
Hean Sulemani gwasin ghweelmeeda aba damandida, niny sea fuga sean bea Israeli, guuyeeda haw, ng'eada Hamati ea gagul eenda Misri, madeeda NG'UTAMIIDA was ASEETEANYA, aba eemooji ispwa.

Eaweeteaba sis goojeakta buuneeda gaweay; hean gabadiischeesa sugoocheanda, nea gabiikta gealga nyaawa aba hooseaneega nea gang'weela gurooruunatka nyaawa aba miyinda niihiimsa NG'UTAMIIDA siidaanyi bea gadiyeeda was Dawdi ea heeda fugaaschi bea Israeli.
